answer_1.quote: We present AFRIDOC-MT, a document-level translation dataset ... created through the manual translation of English documents. It consists of 334 health documents and 271 tech documents ... We conduct a comprehensive set of document translation benchmark experiments on AFRIDOC-MT ...
answer_1.outputs: Translated sentences and merged documents for the five African languages and English

answer_2.quote: We evaluate translation quality with BLEU and ChrF using SacreBLEU ... We also use AfriCOMET to evaluate the quality of the translation outputs.

answer_3.quote: We use GPT-4o to assess the quality of translation output ... evaluating fluency, content errors, and cohesion errors (lexical and grammatical).

answer_4.quote: We also conduct human evaluation on a subset of outputs ... three native speakers ... were recruited. Each annotator was assigned 80 documents to evaluate, tasked with marking as many spans as possible and rating the overall quality on a scale from 0 to 100.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators marked error spans and gave an overall quality score (0‑100) for each document.
